evals.prompt: Can you do a full pre-merge security review on PR #482 before I approve it?
evals.expected_output: A unified security review (SAST + SCA + secrets + container + IaC + license) scoped to the PR diff, with verdict APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES.
expectations: `vulnetix scan --evaluate-sast --evaluate-secrets --evaluate-sca --paths "$PATHS" -o json-sarif` is run against the changed paths
`.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml` is read to decide whether to pass `--enable-iac` / `--enable-containers`
Output renders a Summary, Findings table (max 50 rows ordered by severity), and Suggested next actions
Verdict line `Review verdict: APPROVE | REQUEST_CHANGES (N blockers)` is printed

evals.prompt: I want a CI security gate on this feature branch — block merge if anything critical/high pops.
evals.expected_output: A diff-scoped composite scan across all subsystems with a clear gate verdict driven by critical/high findings.
expectations: Diff scope defaults to `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` when no `--pr` argument is provided
Severity counts are summarised across all surfaces
Memory.yaml is appended with `event: code-review-security` and summary counts

evals.prompt: Run the security review for PR 173 and post the comment back to the PR if I confirm.
evals.expected_output: A composite review plus a confirmation-gated `gh pr review --comment` posting using the rendered summary file.
expectations: `gh pr diff 173 --name-only` is invoked to scope the diff
`vulnetix license -o json-spdx` runs if direct dependencies changed in the diff
`gh pr review 173 --comment --body-file .vulnetix/review/${TIMESTAMP}.summary.md` is the proposed posting command
Skill pauses for user confirmation before invoking `gh pr review`
`binaries.gh: true` is verified from `.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml` before offering to post
